summary: M39z · Verified auto-sanction on Division Accept + new Finance Console tabs (Extras, Invoices, DA/TA, Actuals, Claims, Receipts, Closure). Backend pytest 11/11 GREEN. Frontend UI verified across MPCA + Division personas — 9 tabs for MPCA, 6 tabs for Division, DivisionBudgetCard renders all three states (Sent_To_Division shows 'Accept & Sanction' + Request Revision + italic hint 'MPCA authored this budget — accepting sanctions it immediately and unlocks spending.'; Approved shows 'Sanctioned · you may now upload invoices, DA/TA & claims'; Revision_Requested legacy transitional message). Extras tab opens new-eer-dialog on button click. Claims tab renders claims-panel with claims-empty + claims-open-legacy-btn 'Start Claim'. Privacy scoping honoured — Division caller cannot see other body's budget_total_inr in matrix.
critical_code_review_comments: division_accept endpoint (finance_console.py:372-438) correctly copies proposed → approved fields, sets both division_accepted_* and sanctioned_* stamps in one write, and appends a single approval_chain step (stage=Approved, decision=Sanctioned). Idempotent by 409 on non-Sent_To_Division status.
Scope guard at line 390-391 correctly allows MPCA header as override — verified programmatically. Body_id defaults to doc's body_id when payload omits actor_body_id.
Legacy /sanction endpoint retained (line 481) — returns 409 on Sent_To_Division and Approved (verified). Still callable for stuck Accepted_By_Division docs.
DivisionBudgetCard hint text is a nice UX cue — makes the ‘why is my Accept also a Sanction?’ signal explicit. Good.
ClaimsPanel — 'Start Claim' routes to legacy Finance view for signing; consider surfacing an inline draft form eventually so Divisions don’t bounce between two console layouts.

TournamentFinanceConsole.jsx has grown to 1095 lines with 4+ subcomponents in-file (ClaimsPanel, DivisionBudgetCard, MatrixRow, ExtraExpenseTab). Consider splitting into /pages/finance/*.jsx modules per component for maintainability (>700 line rule).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (9 tabs MPCA, 6 tabs Division, all data-testids present + interactive)

seed_data_creation: Consumed several Sent_To_Division rows in tournament 1c60fc28 while testing: DIV-GWL and DIV-SHD auto-sanctioned to Approved; DIV-IND, DIV-CHM, DIV-BPL, DIV-RWA transitioned to Revision_Requested.
